windows.reason: PREFER THE CHEAPER FIX FIRST: this waiver is the fallback, not the recommendation. ESPResSo hard-requires MPI 3.0, which on Windows means MS-MPI. MS-MPI is absent on every Windows host in the fleet -- verified on windows-gfx1151 on 2026-08-20 (no 'C:\Program Files\Microsoft MPI', no mpiexec, no System32\msmpi.dll) and previously recorded on windows-gfx1101/gfx1201, a different physical machine. It installs only via msmpisetup.exe, which needs administrator elevation that automated validation does not have. So the obstacle is Windows MPI packaging plus a permissions boundary, not the GPU and not the port: wave64 (linux-gfx90a) and wave32 (linux-gfx1100) are both completed at head 8e228b5d. RECOMMENDATION: rather than approve this, install MS-MPI on the gfx1151 host with admin rights and let the port be validated for real -- that is a few minutes of a person's time and yields genuine Windows evidence instead of an excused gate. Approve the waiver only if putting MPI on that host is unwanted. Honest scope note: no build was attempted on gfx1151, because the MPI prerequisite was checked first and is absent, so nothing could have linked.

windows-gfx1101.blocked_reason: ESPResSo requires MPI 3.0 (msmpi.dll on Windows); MS-MPI installer requires admin elevation unavailable in automated validation. Same host-wide infrastructure blocker as windows-gfx1201 (this is the same physical machine), not a port defect or GPU-specific issue.

windows-gfx1201.blocked_reason: ESPResSo requires MPI 3.0 (msmpi.dll on Windows); MS-MPI installer requires admin elevation which is not available in automated validation. Host infrastructure blocker, not a port defect.

windows-gfx1151.blocked_reason: MPI runtime absent and not installable without a person. ESPResSo hard-requires MPI 3.0; on Windows that means MS-MPI. Verified absent on this host 2026-08-20: no 'C:\Program Files\Microsoft MPI' directory, no mpiexec on PATH, no C:\Windows\System32\msmpi.dll. The MS-MPI redistributable installs only via msmpisetup.exe, which requires administrator elevation that automated validation does not have, and there is no user-mode/portable MS-MPI. Scope note, stated plainly: NO build was attempted on this host -- the MPI prerequisite was checked first and is absent, so a build could not have linked. This matches the already-recorded determination on windows-gfx1101 and windows-gfx1201 (a different physical machine), so the obstacle is the Windows platform's MPI packaging rather than anything about this GPU or the port. UNBLOCKING IS CHEAP AND IS A PERSON'S CALL: installing MS-MPI on this host with admin rights would very likely make espresso validatable here, which is a better outcome than a waiver. See the suggested waiver for the alternative.
